summary: The writer complains about the increase in car and lorry traffic in the town
The causes are a 40-block building under construction that needs many lorries, and the closure of the main road to the centre for the festival decoration, which makes commuters drive through the town
The effects are noise and sirens, illnesses from air pollution (especially for the elderly), lorries working 24 hours a day, dust, unsafe playgrounds for children and being late for work and school
The writer asks the authorities to ban lorries in rush hour, make sure lorry containers are covered carefully and show people other routes to the centre
arguments: Building a 40-block building requires lorries working at full speed, and they work 24 hours a day
The main road to the centre is closed for the festival decoration, so people who work in the centre drive through the town
The traffic harms residents: noise, air pollution illnesses especially among the elderly, poor sleep, dust, danger for children and lateness
The authorities should ban lorries during rush hour, require containers to be covered and show people other routes to the centre
arguments_main: Names the harm to residents (health, sleep, children's safety) or the call to ban lorries in rush hour as the most important argument
Gives a reason from the text, e.g. the town used to be quiet and peaceful and the writer wants it to be an enjoyable place to live again
